content: How would I go about finding what the replacement for Array.get? is?

Sorry, I found it here: https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Init/Prelude.html#Array.getD
"To return an [Option](https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Init/Prelude.html#Option) depending on whether the index is in bounds, use a[i]?. To panic if the index is out of bounds, use a[i]!."
